newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SBC, Barclays units buy Manila bourse seats.
newsitem.headline: SBC, Barclays units buy Manila bourse seats.

text.p: The investment arms of Swiss Bank Corp and Barclays Bank Plc have bought one seat each on the Philippine Stock Exchange, an official of the bourse said on Tuesday.

SBC Warburg Phils Inc, a division of SBC Warburg Asia Ltd, bought a seat from local brokerage L.M. Garcia and Associates Inc for 75 million pesos while Barclays de Zoete Wedd Ltd bought its seat from Jardine Fleming Phils Inc for an undetermined amount, the exchange official who declined to be named said.

"Rosy prospects in the Philippine economy have attracted both investment firms to buy seats in the local exchange," the official said, adding that the price of a broker card hit a peak of 85 million pesos early this year. Since then, prices have slipped back to 75 million pesos.
